opportunities.title: Training Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or the course you wish to attend is being held in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become Society members; others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,200 to enable members to attend formal short training courses or a collaborative visit to another laboratory to train in specific genetic/genomic techniques.

opportunities.title: Junior Scientist Conference Grants

amount.raw: up to £200 (Scheme A); up to £500 (Scheme B); up to £750 (Adelphi co‑sponsored); up to £300 (virtual)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scheme A: undergraduate, Master’s and PhD student members and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva. Schemes B & C: PhD students and postdoctoral scientists within six years of their PhD viva. Applicants must be Genetics Society members (students can apply as soon as they become members; others need at least one year membership).
opportunities.summary: Supports attendance of Genetics Society junior scientist members at conferences (Society‑organised, other meetings, or virtual conferences) with travel, accommodation and registration cost grants.

opportunities.title: Heredity Fieldwork Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: All members of the Genetics Society can apply, as long as you are studying or working in the UK, or you intend to carry out your fieldwork in the UK. Students can apply as soon as they become members; others should be a Society member for at least one year.
opportunities.summary: Awards up to £2,000 to cover travel and accommodation costs associated with a field‑based genetic research project suitable for publication in the journal Heredity.

opportunities.title: Public Engagement Grant
opportunities.summary: Grants of up to £1,000 to support public engagement activities related to genetics, covering eligible travel and materials costs.

opportunities.title: One‑off Meeting Grant
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Genetics Society may apply at any time.
opportunities.summary: Sponsorship of genetic‑themed meetings not organised directly by the Genetics Society, covering meeting costs and a Carer’s Award.

opportunities.title: Special Interest Group Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Groups applying to become a new Special Interest Group; applicants must be members of the Genetics Society.
opportunities.summary: Funding up to £2,000 per year to support regular series of research meetings on particular genetics themes.
